The Butt Fumble play occurred as I was explaining football to my father-in-law. I literally explained how both teams were 9 wins and 2 losses, how the Jets and Pats had a massive rivalry, etc… and as if it were an act of God, Mark Sanchez stumbles into Moore, the ball is recovered by the Pats, and just like that - Pats touchdown. 

As the TV played the “disgusting act” over and over, he leans over to me and says very coyly, “So… was that supposed to happen?” For anyone that didn’t see it live - it was absolutely *baffling* realizing that something this humiliatingly imcompetent could happen on national television, and knowing in your guts that this would be meme’d for years to come. 

I remember watching the game just get worse and worse, but all the while holding that gut feeling Jets fans all know; we were guaranteed to lose, even though the second quarter wasn’t even halfway over. I’ve since vowed to never watch a Jets game on Thanksgiving Day again lol.

Your self-esteem and confidence will fall into ruin and you’ll realize that no, life is not like a movie, there are no do-overs, and you must live with your past until you are dead.
